cases.text: Postmortem, checkout outage. The payment service has a pool of 12 workers and a waiting queue of 30. Each payment call takes 25 ms. The order service runs 80 workers. Traffic was a steady 66 requests per second. About 40 percent of requests missed the cache. During the incident the payment provider was roughly 10 times slower than normal.

Incident notes:
- gateway: 200 workers, queue 150, 3 ms per request
- payment: 8 workers, queue 10, 30 ms per request
- db: 25 workers, queue 60, 12 ms per request
- load: one request every 25 ms
- payment degraded to 15 times its usual latency

payment:
  workers: 16
  queue_size: 50

  workers: 40
  queue_size: 40
# traffic peaked at 30 requests per second
Payment calls normally take 0.04 s each. The cache miss rate was 15%. We receive a request every 25 ms. Under the fault payment was 5 times slower.
Checkout was failing for about an hour. The payment dependency was around 20 times slower than usual. We rolled back the deploy but it did not help. No other numbers were captured.
Notes from the call: payment has 10 workers. Later someone corrected this in chat: payment has 16 workers. Payment calls take 20 ms.
